g.title: j3032698261
g.text: I realized I know very little about where you came from, or how you grew up. Would you be willing to tell me anything?

g.title: j2397636094
g.text: [Warning: Brief mention of child abuse. Click here to end. No Chemistry loss with Lyon will be incurred.]

g.title: j2497026849
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j367054140
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2377729301
g.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries, and the grandparents who met during the Gaullique Revolution. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?

g.title: j2497026849->j2377729301
g.text: LyonBackstory1, LyonBackstory2

g.title: j3213762330
g.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?

g.title: j2497026849->j3842194739

g.title: j2600705609
g.text: I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1174842684
g.text: Why would you think it's wasting time?

g.title: j394726100
g.text: It isn't wasted time to me, Lyon. I would really love to know you better.

g.title: j1979479445
g.text: Never mind, then. If you'd rather not.

g.title: j404620867
g.text: I would simply think there are better ways for you to spend your energies. Such as defending some bastion against an encroaching enemy party, discovering unknown knowledge... or sorting clothing.

g.title: j1584197471
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j331146870
g.text: No, forgive me. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.

g.title: j3266729307
g.text: Lyon, if you'd prefer I just go away, please say so.

g.title: j155924658
g.text: You're not exactly making this any easier.

g.title: j248264766
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1584197471->j248264766
g.text: LyonFirstFlirt

g.title: j3209603194
g.text: Have you settled on a path, now? Or are your nerves simply more frayed than mine, perhaps?

g.title: j1584197471->j3209603194
g.text: LyonFlirtIgnored

g.title: j4128531405
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1584197471->j4128531405
g.text: false

g.title: j2242775033
g.text: I am not quite often certain how one is to properly respond in situations such as simple curiosity over one's history - or even benign expressions of friendship.

g.title: j775560080
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j446373103
g.text: Yes, and it is this... sentiment that makes me increasingly trepidatious, I must admit. For my peace of mind, simply confirm for me that you mean what I am more and more increasingly fear you might.

g.title: j2344890220
g.text: I'm sorry for ignoring you earlier...

g.title: j2747963031
g.text: What do you mean...?

g.title: j1008088599
g.text: I... find that your choice of words makes me trepidatious, I must admit. Though I do not know if you mean them the way I am interpreting them.

g.title: j2819011193
g.text: Regardless - you were enquiring as to my past, yes?

g.title: j2143471607
g.text: I'll put you at peace, then - I don't have feelings for you.

g.title: j294902614
g.text: Is it so hard for you to believe I might have feelings for you, Lyon?

g.title: j1261838688
g.text: You abandoned the pursuit with as much fervor as you began it. I assumed you had rightly decided it was a poor decision.

g.title: j438827762
g.text: It has likely come to your attention by now that I see... visions. This has been a part of my life ever since I was a small child.

g.title: j2250221314
g.text: I did not mean to rebuff you, but it is good to know where we stand. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.

g.title: j255465768
g.text: Boolean DrifterLyon is now true.

g.title: j2170773743
g.text: You're right, this is all a mistake.

g.title: j3217323720
g.text: I just wasn't sure if my advances were welcome.

g.title: j925141951
g.text: These visions have not often been pleasant ones, to say the least.

g.title: j912734479
g.text: Simply put? Well, yes. I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.

g.title: j2649660841
g.text: I thought as much. I will therefore simply wish you a good rest of your day.

g.title: j2827743202
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2084209842
g.text: And you think the visions came from Lua?

g.title: j144288654
g.text: What did they entail?

g.title: j3884668248
g.text: Did they scare you?

g.title: j1185888640
g.text: If you are set upon this path, I shall not deter you and I... I have found as unsettled and... foreign to me as this is?

g.title: j1535391566
g.text: They are not... unwelcome, per se? They simply are... perplexing, in the fact that they exist at all.

g.title: j100289366
g.text: I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.

g.title: j141018455
g.text: I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.

g.title: j483406253
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2900774828
g.text: Would you prefer I stop?

g.title: j2404998783
g.text: So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.

g.title: j930766348
g.text: So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.

g.title: j423958114
g.text: I am... perhaps, cautiously hopeful to see where this new path leads. However - you were enquiring as to my past, yes?

g.title: j2305914300
g.text: No, I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.

g.title: j2009104428
g.text: Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.

g.title: j103856956
g.text: Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.

g.title: j2963837420
g.text: Boolean LyonFlirt2 is now true.

g.title: j1882699125
g.text: For she had none at all.

g.title: j3673665310
g.text: For she had none at all.

g.title: j2308788946
g.text: Three months later, a woman in the village was discovered dead in her home. Her eyes, devoured by rats.

g.title: j719778827
g.text: Three months later, a woman in the village was discovered dead in her home. Her eyes, devoured by rats.

g.title: j554777531
g.text: I told my mother of what I had seen, the night the vision had woken me. She remembered what I had seen, same as I.

g.title: j447745238
g.text: Yes, Drifter. The visions frightened me.

g.title: j2845667059
g.text: What did she do?

g.title: j1300074705
g.text: Did she think it was a coincidence, or a sign?

g.title: j890239047
g.text: She beat me with a switch until I could no longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"

g.title: j3824317494
g.text: I do not know. All I know is she beat me with a switch until I could not longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"

g.title: j1350226501
g.text: How old were you?

g.title: j1881752954
g.text: Oh, Lyon... I am so, so sorry...

g.title: j521037269
g.text: That's terrible...

g.title: j255991519
g.text: She was ignorant. She didn't know any better.

g.title: j4007306128
g.text: Four, perhaps. Six, at the oldest. I do not know. We did not track our years with the same vehemence as you do now.

g.title: j525730647
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2698478763
g.text: Check boolean LyonPainOff

g.title: j4113430036
g.text: My mother was long dead when we left to come here. And now, she is but dust. She lived a life of misery... and misery she was doomed to spread.

g.title: j450336454
g.text: To hurt a child... It's unforgivable.

g.title: j2698478763->j450336454
g.text: true

g.title: j2698478763->j450336454
g.text: false

g.title: j556553254
g.text: Is that why you...?

g.title: j2698478763->j556553254
g.text: false

g.title: j171347215
g.text: She was frightened. Whatever ails me, be it a burden of the gods, madness - a curse - she was ill-equipped to handle.

g.title: j2933368378
g.text: Check boolean LyonLecture2

g.title: j1396094918
g.text: Regardless, for as cruel as my mother was? My father was worse. I shall spare you the details.

g.title: j3061627380
g.text: Perhaps. I have often wondered if it was not part of the compulsion. But as have told you before, it is also a method of Lua.

g.title: j2933368378->j3061627380
g.text: true

g.title: j2387330275
g.text: Perhaps. I have often wondered if it was not part of the compulsion. But it is a method of Lua, of the Luminaries. I am not alone in its practice.

g.title: j2933368378->j2387330275
g.text: false

g.title: j2263286335
g.text: As I grew older, the visions turned to voices. Whispers that came to me at all hours. Waking and dreaming. My work upon the farm suffered for it, and I suffered in turn.

g.title: j1710797333
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4267952042
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3361147799
g.text: What sent you to the church?

g.title: j2638429938
g.text: Some people do not deserve to be parents.

g.title: j829511724
g.text: I insist to you that it brings me a modicum of peace, though I know it must still seem strange to you that it does so.

g.title: j3156074795
g.text: It was taught to me by one of the other Fathers at the Cathedral, to help me... clear my mind. Those who are chosen by Lua are often "blessed" by "visions."

g.title: j4013567020
g.text: Check boolean LyonPainOff

g.title: j2283511529
g.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but I cannot also understate how difficult of a child I was to contend with, especially once I was taller and stronger in stature than them.

g.title: j344435275
g.text: Boolean LyonLecture2 is now true.

g.title: j3702232000
g.text: My visions and the voices would often send me into violent fits, Drifter. Torturing myself was often the only way to wake myself from what I saw.

g.title: j4013567020->j3702232000
g.text: true

g.title: j1769388169
g.text: My visions and the voices would often send me into violent fits, Drifter. I would often take a knife to carve my own flesh, as the pain would be the only thing to wake me from them.

g.title: j4013567020->j1769388169
g.text: false

g.title: j1443004548
g.text: But it was when the voices instructed me to

g.title: j433827219
g.text: I... I cannot. I simply cannot. Forgive me. My hands are trembling as I type this. I must stop for now.

g.title: j326646181
g.text: Of course. It's okay. There's no rush. I'm here, anytime you're ready.

g.title: j844011583
g.text: I understand, this has been so much already. Rest, okay? And... thank you. This means a lot to me.

g.title: j170331128
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j91148681
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j3869170088
g.text: Thank you. I will speak to you soon.

g.title: j3282902326
g.text: And to me. More than you can know, I think. Thank you in return, my friend. I will speak to you soon.
